scope: Actual individual view of phase1 slide-01.png through slide-20.png only

slides.review_note: Title, subtitle and university-template layout readable; no algorithm-final-name or calibrated-performance claim.
Report structure readable; three parallel work areas and appendix placement clear.
Actual installation photo and enlargement readable; caption correctly defers geometric calibration to records.
Body yaw versus velocity course distinction correct; independent of continuous forward motion does not claim independent GNSS lineage.
Two research questions and natural/fault validation paths clear.
b=p2-p1 arrow correctly points from GNSS1 to GNSS2; IMU→GNSS1 lever arrow correct. Nominal length and declared lever/point distinction explicit.
Table is readable; information-level fairness caveat appropriate. English word wrap and SDK role need refinement.
Left sources→admission→EKF/output arrow directions correct. Shared dependency is simplified but described later. Dual-position-difference label ambiguous.
Six sources and actual HV heading/scheduling dependency readable; carrier status is an admission condition, not a correctness proof.
Baseline-difference heading and projection amplification concept correct; angular-unit and notation clarification required.
Left-to-right software gate arrows correctly directed; fixed-status-not-probability caveat retained. Hardware clock distinction recommended.

Residual pred−obs equation and soft/hard gate table readable; residual includes observation/prediction common effects. Original covariance multiplier/source identity not numerically rechecked in this PNG-only pass.
15-active-state presentation avoids all-21-active claim; frozen six scale slots and Joseph update named. Standard covariance/innovation equations readable.
GNSS1 fork into RV/RD then estimator is semantically correct; RV remains when RD disabled; independence is not claimed.
All inputs point into transform then HV, but the displayed transform is incomplete and must distinguish engineering Ĉ from true attitude.
Order arrows visually correct; source availability and scheduling limitations readable, with acceptance wording refinement advised.
Inflation-cap bar chart and formula readable; engineering weight is explicitly separated from metrological uncertainty. No independent re-evaluation of cap values here.
Reference-agreement caveat is correct, but input bus falsely visually connects Go2 IMU/SDK to commercial reference.
Three windows, duration/matched epochs/path lengths table readable. Numbers are rendered, not independently recalculated; selection/nonblind and original-version scope need explicit labeling.
Rendered matrix arithmetic 541×11=5951,45×11=495,2×11=22,total6468 and588cases is internally consistent; independence disclaimer is present.

issues.observation: Rendered HV equation omits declared gain k and FLU→FRD M; uses C rather than engineering proxy Ĉ and shows SDK pitch without the actual negative-pitch construction. Historical A1 label can imply a delayed online observation.
issues.requested_change: Use z_H=k Π_H Ĉ M v_SDK(FLU), M=diag(1,-1,-1); explicitly state Ĉ=Rz(pre-generated projection heading) Ry(-SDK pitch) Rx(SDK roll). Rename historical A1 to pre-generated dual-position-difference heading. Do not imply Ĉ is calibrated true attitude.

issues.observation: The Go2 IMU/SDK line enters the same vertical branch bus used for shared GNSS; that bus also points into the commercial reference. This visually depicts Go2 IMU/SDK being consumed by the commercial reference, which is not evidenced.
issues.requested_change: Fork only shared GNSS into commercial reference and proposed estimator. Connect Go2 IMU/SDK separately to proposed estimator, with no merge into the upper reference branch. Keep camera/own IMU within reference.

issues.observation: δψ≈δb_perp/||b_H|| is a radian small-angle relation, while the nearby heading formula is rendered with +90 degrees. δb_perp and b_H are undefined on the page.
issues.requested_change: Mark δψ in rad; define δb_perp as signed transverse horizontal baseline error and b_H as horizontal baseline projection. If degrees are used, include 180/π.

issues.observation: Frozen-setting transfer check for H/O can be read as blind held-out evaluation. Historical configuration/selection had reference-visible development and previously viewed O results. This page does not disclose that boundary.
issues.requested_change: Add a concise boundary: same-installation sequence transfer, not an unseen-data/independent-installation blind test; historical selection saw reference/results. Bind these counts as original V3 rather than diagnostic rerun counts.

issues.observation: Doppler is split across table lines as Do / ppler in proposed-input cell.
issues.requested_change: Use an intentional line break before Doppler or widen/rephrase the cell so the English word stays intact.

issues.observation: SDK weak prior does not identify the actual SDK inclination and horizontal-velocity observation paths.
issues.requested_change: Prefer robot body IMU plus SDK inclination/horizontal-velocity aiding; clarify actual measurement updates rather than only initialization priors.

issues.observation: 双位置差 is ambiguous wording for a difference between two receiver position solutions.
时间精确配对 is tied to integer iTOW in the subtitle, but physical synchronization is not distinguished on the diagram.
issues.requested_change: Prefer 整数iTOW精确配键; add that software pairing does not establish synchronization of all hardware/IMU/reference clocks.

issues.observation: GNSS event valid + provider valid -> enters update could be read as guaranteed accepted measurement. Enabled flags, range checks and gates still matter.
issues.requested_change: Say enters corresponding admission/update procedure; acceptance is determined by actual dispatch and gates.
